voices.note: the mishna 16a.15-16b.2 (המקבל צאן ברזל מן הגוי)
anonymous redactorial voice of this piska

props.gloss_en: one who receives iron sheep from a gentile: their offspring are exempt
the stam: is this to say that since the owner has not taken the money, [the iron sheep] stand in the owner's possession?
one does not receive iron sheep from a Jew, because it is interest
the stam: evidently they stand in the recipient's possession
Abaye: this [our mishna] is where he accepted on himself accident and depreciation
Abaye: and that [the Bava Metzia mishna] is where he did not accept on himself accident and depreciation
Rava: both this and that are where he did not accept on himself accident and depreciation

Rava: here, regarding the firstborn, the reason is: if the gentile comes wanting money and is not paid, he seizes the animal, and if he does not find the animal he seizes its offspring -- so the gentile's hand is in the middle
Rava: and wherever the gentile's hand is in the middle, it is exempt from the firstborn law

supports.gloss_en: למימרא -- from the mishna's exempting the offspring, the sheep would be in the gentile owner's possession
אלמא -- since it is interest, the sheep are the recipient's (a loan)

objections.gloss_en: ורמינהו: אין מקבלין צאן ברזל מישראל מפני שהוא רבית -- אלמא ברשותא דמקבל קיימא!

answered_by.gloss_en: לא קשיא: הא דקביל עליה אונסא וזולא, והא דלא קביל (= p_abaye_hacha_kibel, p_abaye_hatam_lo_kibel; refuted by Rava at 16b.6-7)
אלא אמר רבא: אידי ואידי דלא קביל, והכא גבי בכורה היינו טעמא -- יד גוי באמצע (= p_rava_idei_veidei_lo_kibel, p_rava_yad_goy_baemtza, p_rava_kol_yad_goy_patur)

objections.gloss_en: אמר ליה רבא: דקביל עליה אונסא וזולא, ״צאן ברזל״ קרית ליה? -- if the owner bears accident and depreciation it is not iron sheep at all
ועוד, מאי פסקא? -- what makes [each mishna] decisive [for one kind], when both say 'iron sheep' unqualified?
ועוד, אדתני סיפא אבל מקבלין צאן ברזל מן הגוי -- ליפלוג וליתני בדידה: במה דברים אמורים? דלא קביל עליה אונסא וזולא, אבל קביל -- שפיר דמי!
